data: An original cheerful Mandarin children's adventure song about a little Monkey King travelling with friends, for ages 5 to 9. Clear sweet female lead vocal, friendly natural singing, simple catchy pentatonic melody, playful bamboo flute, plucked pipa, warm acoustic guitar, light woodblocks and soft hand drums. Sunny, brave, kind and magical, never scary. Easy to sing along, clear Mandarin diction, brief instrumental intro and a complete gentle ending. 108 BPM, D major, polished children's animation opening song.
